model: Research ADM point-mass 1PN + leading SO, N=3 canonical x/p/S, G=1
initial_frame: Translate by Newtonian mass centroid and subtract m_i*sum(p)/sum(m) ONCE at initialization; fixed canonical frame thereafter, no ephemeris input
scaling: Each body's initial |x|, |p|, |S| separately, all required nonzero. P drift divided by sum initial |p|, H by |H0|, J by |J0|. No epsilon fallback.
interpretation: Exact numerical flow of a finite selected H, not complete GR at higher orders and not an extended-body lunar model. No tides, spin-spin, 2PN, NLO SO, I/q/Q2, future DE441 or parameter fit.
